item_short_desc: Maintain the shape and life of your shoes with Kiwi’s Plastic Shoe Tree. The Lightweight material makes it an ideal accessory for traveling while fitting most shoe styles and sizes.
description: Maintain the shape and life of your shoes with Kiwi’s Plastic Shoe Tree. The Lightweight material makes it an ideal accessory for traveling while fitting most shoe styles and sizes. Insert Shoe Tree into the front part of the shoe and lift up handle to adjust notch to your proper fit - then push handle down into place for a secure fit.
